code.description: The leave-category code the cross-source alias binding matches on

deduct_from_primary_pay_category.description: Whether the deduction follows the primary pay category

default_deduct_from_pay_category_referen.description: Source id of the tenant-configured pay category this category deducts from

exclude_from_termination_payout.description: Whether the category is excluded from a termination payout

external_code.description: Stable manufacturer/award code where the source supplies one

hide_accruals_on_payslip.description: Whether accruals are hidden on the payslip

is_balance_untracked.description: Whether the category is excluded from balance tracking

is_name_private.description: Whether the category is hidden from payslips by name

is_pay_run_accrual.description: Whether accrual happens at pay-run time

is_private.description: Source privacy flag for the category

leave_category_type.description: The category's leave type (annual / personal-carer's / long service / …)

leave_code_entity_id.description: Demiton canonical `LEAVE_CODE` spine node this fact is about

leave_entitlement.description: Entitlement value where the source supplies one

leave_loading_rate.description: Leave loading applied to this category

leave_unit_type.description: The source's second unit field; its distinction from `unitType` is unverified

legal_entity_id.description: Owning legal entity where the source is multi-company

name.description: Human name of the leave category

payout_as_etp.description: Whether the category pays out as an employment termination payment

prevent_negative_balance_unpaid_leave_ca.description: Source id of the tenant-configured category used to prevent a negative unpaid balance

source_classification.description: The source's own classification of the category's origin

source_external_id.description: The raw record id in the producing system

source_system.description: The bound system that produced this record (`ASSIGNAR`/`KEYPAY`/…)

statutory_leave_type.description: The ATO paid-leave type this category maps to (O/P/W/A/C/U)

transfer_on_termination_pay_category_ref.description: Source id of the tenant-configured pay category used on termination

transfer_to_pay_category_reference.description: Source id of the tenant-configured pay category this category transfers into

unit_type.description: Unit the entitlement and balance are denominated in

units.description: The source's unit count/denomination for the category

use_deduct_from_pay_category_rate.description: Whether the deducting category's rate is used
